relations.statement: For any matrix H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) GaussRat, if H is SectorAdditive then for distinct i j we have (H j i).im - (H i j).im = 0.
relations.hypotheses: H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) GaussRat, hA : SectorAdditive H, i j : Fin n, hneq : i ≠ j
